Maya: Quick sync — experiment plan for next week's webinar + launch posts. Goal: increase PLG activation via free credits + prompt template pack. Target: 2k signups, 18-22% activation within 7 days. :rocket:

Sam G: Nice. How are we splitting cohorts? dev vs enterprise? or by initial usage signal?

Maya: Thinking 3 cohorts: dev (low friction), product-led (tutorial templates), enterprise trial (SaaS use-cases). Basic matrix attached — will post in drive.

Joel P: Benchmarks to track: time-to-first-success, avg tokens to success, retention at D7, cost per activated user. Also need baseline numbers from last webinar.

Ana - Growth: Messaging should vary: dev = \"get a working prompt in 5 min\", enterprise = \"SLA & privacy\". Can A/B test two hero lines on landing.

Sam G: Can we def a test matrix now? e.g.\n\n```
Cohort | Hero copy A | Hero copy B | Credit amount
Dev    | quickstart | templates-first | $10
PLG    | prompt pack | workshop access  | $25
Enterprise | compliance-first | SLA mention  | $100
```

Joel P: Suggest microbenchmarks per cohort and one cross-cohort metric: activated per $ spent.

GrowthBot: Reminder: webinar scheduled for 2024-09-21 10:00 PT — registration form: https://redwood.ai/events/webinar

Maya: I'll draft the launch posts (LinkedIn, X thread, hackernews teaser) — will ping with copy by EOD. Also prepping prompt templates repo and a one-click import.

Ana - Growth: I'll map inbound routing: high-MRR/enterprise leads -> sales-assist; otherwise auto-nudge drip with credit redemption email.

Sam G: I'll build the registration segments and pass over GA + Amplitude events to Joel.

Joel P: I'll pull baseline metrics and wire up the dashboards. We'll want funnel slices by cohort + source.

Maya: Action items: Maya — launch copy + assets; Sam — segments + tracking; Joel — dashboards + baselines; Ana — routing + emails. Sync tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:

Sam G: Sounds good. Adding note: keep credit redemption simple (1-click claim) to reduce friction.

Ana - Growth: Agreed. Also let's include a short in-webinar prompt lab for immediate activation.

Maya: Love that. Okay team — will share the doc and creative in #marketing and update calendar invite.
